title: Chapter 130 — Handling Complaints
intro: Appliance retail has its own complaint universe — and each scenario has a script.

sections.title: The Complaint Mindset
sections.content:
Every complaint is an opportunity to prove who you are. A customer whose complaint was handled well is statistically more loyal than one who never had a problem. This is the Service Recovery Paradox — proven research, not wishful thinking.

The mindset shift: from 'this is a problem' to 'this is a chance to earn a customer for life.'

sections.title: Scenario Scripts
sections.content:
Delivery damage: 'That should not have happened and I apologize. I am documenting this right now with photos, filing the claim, and scheduling a replacement delivery at the earliest slot. You should not wait because of our mistake.'

Wrong item delivered: 'I am going to fix this today. Let me confirm the correct model and arrange the swap. I will personally verify it before it goes on the truck.'

DOA — dead on arrival: 'A brand new appliance that does not work is unacceptable. Let me pull a replacement from our floor stock right now and get it to you tomorrow. You should not have to wait.'

Late delivery: 'I should have called you before the window closed — that is on us. Let me reschedule for the earliest available slot and I will personally confirm the timing.'

sections.title: Follow-Up After Resolution
sections.content:
After every complaint resolution, call the customer the next day. 'Hi [name], I just wanted to make sure everything is resolved and you are feeling good about it. Is there anything else I can do?'

That follow-up call is where complaints turn into loyalty. The customer tells their friends: 'I had a problem, but [rep] handled it so well I would buy from them again in a heartbeat.'
